Intoniva `v0.3.0-alpha.20` testing build.

- Privacy, terms, refund, and cookies pages are linked from App details and the project website.
- Light-theme accent text has higher contrast. Selected controls keep the green background and dark text.
- App details announces expanded/collapsed sections to screen readers and restores their state.
- Website keyboard navigation, image alternatives, and mobile legal-page layouts improved.
- Privacy notices distinguish local app processing, GitHub Pages hosting, optional payments, and support correspondence.
- Official app-build use is permitted; source code and original assets remain proprietary.

The audio-recognition engine is unchanged. This release does not include the experimental neural chord model.

The APK is debug-signed for direct testing and is not the Google Play bundle.
Use the attached SHA-256 file to verify the download. The app has no ads,
accounts, analytics, tracking, Internet permission, or advertising ID.

Policies: https://majkey25.github.io/TuneItAll/legal/
Review and remaining publisher-identification checks: `docs/legal-and-accessibility-review-2026-09-08.md`.
